item.title: What Happens When WhatsApp Goes Down and It's Your Only Channel?
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers What Happens When WhatsApp Goes Down and It’s Your Only Channel? On Monday, August 3rd, WhatsApp went down for hours. For many businesses, that meant losing their only way to reach customers: no orders, no confirmations, no appointment reminders, no replies. It wasn’t the first outage, and it won’t be the last. You breathe out because it was only a day, only a few hours. But the real problem was never technical.
